scripts.build-it-up: npx concurrently "npm run setup:frontend" "npm run setup:backend"
scripts.start-it-up: npx concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && . env/bin/activate && pip3 install -r requirements.txt && pip install --upgrade pip
scripts.dev:backend: node -e "if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) throw new Error('DATABASE_URL is not set; select a short-lived Neon child branch (docs/neon-setup.md)')" && cd backend && . env/bin/activate && pip3 install -r requirements.txt && pip install --upgrade pip && fastapi dev server.py
scripts.start:backend: node -e "if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) throw new Error('DATABASE_URL is not set; select a short-lived Neon child branch (docs/neon-setup.md)')" && cd backend && fastapi dev server.py
